pages.title: Enchanting
pages.text: $(bold)The enchanting table, bookshelves, lapis, the grindstone and the lectern. The table will only offer up to level 5, so the enchantments it gives are the weak ones. Needs Study as well.$(br2)$(thing)Nether Age$(n), ring 8.$(br)$(thing)22 Focal Shards$(n).$(br)After Redstone and Study.

pages.title: Task
pages.text: $(bold)$(thing)Mine 48 lapis ore$(n)$(br2)Pays 2 Focal Shards once. Counts only once this node is reachable.

pages.title: Unlocks
